youtube_description:
Physicist Nick Herbert is excited about a new scheme for Faster Than Light Messaging.

Recently Demetrios Kalamidas, who has a degree from CCNY and is currently working at New York nanotech company Raith USA, has proposed an FTL signaling scheme using a novel kind of quantum measurement. His proposal (which Nick Herbert has  called KISS, for "Kalamidas's Instant Signaling Scheme) has been accepted for publication in the March 2013 issue of the Journal of the Optical Society of America. 

More info on Nick's blog: http://quantumtantra.blogspot.com/

There is little doubt that this scheme will eventually be refuted, but in the process there is the possibility that something new about quantum reality will be discovered..

Wood Chopper - Reno DeCaro
